bio: It is well worth making the trip to Jacqueline and Alexander Hahn's restaurant in the Hohensachsen neighbourhood, where you will be rewarded with a pleasant atmosphere and really good food. Not only is the quality spot-on, but there is also an impressive array of dishes, ranging from classic options like Zwiebelrostbraten or Wiener schnitzel to international offerings such as Kashmir curry soup or beef fillet tataki. Food is served in an upscale, tastefully modern setting featuring clean lines and soothing tones....
